description: The chart illustrates benchmark scores across several Korean evaluation datasets for three model variants shown as grouped bars per dataset. The horizontal axis contains the category labels PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG, arranged left to right in that order, with no explicit axis title; the vertical axis represents a numeric score on a linear scale (units not specified), with values shown directly as labels above bars and reaching up to 1.00. Each category displays three adjacent bars: a dark purple bar (model name not visible in the cropped legend) with values 0.42 (PT-EVAL), 0.52 (KoBEST-BQ), 0.71 (KoBEST-CP), 0.50 (KoBEST-HS), 0.69 (KoBEST-SN), and 0.57 (AVG); a light blue bar labeled “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0” with values 0.46, 0.56, 0.74, 0.54, 0.73, and 0.61 respectively; and a light gray bar labeled “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)” that is consistently 1.00 for every category. The bars are grouped by dataset (not stacked), with no visible sorting by magnitude and no special emphasis beyond the numeric annotations above each bar.
